title: Revengeance is Mine, Part Dog
description: Revengeance is Mine, Part Dog — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Return to the Dig Site in Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. Once there, kill [GG] Your Little Sister and recover the scroll from his corpse. Bring the scroll to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Return to the Dig Site in Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. Once there, kill [GG] Your Little Sister and recover the scroll from his corpse. Bring the scroll to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Sir Ving said that you retrieved a *laundry list*? Can't you tell the difference between an ancient mystical scroll that reveals the secrets of life and death and a simple laundry list!? I guess not. Great Gosh at a midsummer's day picnic, you're a worse screw-up than Sir Prize.

Look, I can't emphasize enough how important it is that we get the Ancient Scroll of Ecto Neutrality. If your pea brain can't handle this sort of truth, then you'll just have to trust me.

Okay...deep breaths. I'm in my happy place. I'm in my happy place.

Let's try this again. The next time you get back to the dig site on Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace, look for [GG] Your Little Sister and beat the snot out of him until you get that scroll. Bring it to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate and tell him...let's see...tell him, Oxen or Oroks orbit outside our other ovals.

Turn-in:

Another scroll for...someone...to keep safe? And you say the late Sir Vaiveir told you, Oxen or Oroks orbit outside our other ovals? My word, that's a bit rude of him. Nevertheless, I will certainly mention that to the rightful owner if he or she shows up.

By the way, the only thing on this scroll are poorly-drawn illustrations of Oroks at a wild beach party.

Objectives:

  • Kill [GG] Your Little Sister
  • Well-worn Scroll ×1

Level range: 48–100
